description: Journey — after each change, with gripforge_game_test (the headless playtest). Passing tests are not a finished game: gripforge_game_audit, then gripforge_validate_release. Queue validation on the existing durable job worker. Plays the game with its own controls: the suites each kit declares (several clients joining, leaving and coming back, click orders on the ground, an enemy, a door, a chest, a downed ally, held buttons, a player that plays to an ending) and the headless playtest; endings (victory, defeat, boss defeated) come back as events. A real page that reached an ending, its hardware frame rate and the default screens it opened count for this revision. Returns job and status_url; poll that URL with the existing job tools. Simulation is not end-to-end gameplay proof. 0 credits.
